SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign Reading 6.4.1 Intensive Sign Reading – Play, part of Strand 6 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to identify themes in a play? 2. How are literary texts different from factual ones?
